title: Croatian Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Croatia, featuring tender lamb and a blend of aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: croatian stew vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as onions, carrots, and potatoes

instructions: Heat kissed oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown lamb cubes in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per batch.
Remove browned lamb from pot and set aside.
Add croatian stew vegetables to pot and cook until they begin to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add lamb broth, salt, and black pepper to pot, stirring to combine.
Return browned lamb to pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until lamb is tender.
Stir in yeasty bread cubes and continue to simmer for an additional 15 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
